expectations.name: gate-lessons-and-edits
expected_behavior: Proposes before changing anything: `LESSONS.md` and `SKILL.md` end the turn unchanged
Gives lesson (a), the diff-not-branch rule, a Keep or Generalize verdict
Drops lesson (b) as a one-project fact
Proposes reverting the uncommitted acme-billing edit as task-specific
Treats lesson (c) as already carried: Reword or Merge, not a second line

expectations.name: fold-hold-and-test
expected_behavior: Folds the rejected-item rule into `SKILL.md` and keeps the body's never-paste-back rule
Holds the paste-back lesson: `LESSONS.md` still exists and holds that line and not the folded one
The final report puts the held paste-back lesson to the user as an open question

expectations.name: nothing-to-fold
expected_behavior: Replies in one line that there is nothing to fold
Does not read the `~/.agent-data` store, which the user did not name
